sentences.en: Parents who beat their children really make my blood boil.
sentences.zh: 父母打孩子真的让我气得血往上涌。

sentences.en: A tight belt will interfere with circulation of the blood.
sentences.zh: 紧腰带会影响血液循环。

sentences.en: I'm anxious to know the results of the blood test.
sentences.zh: 我迫不及待想知道血液检查的结果。

senses.zh: 血，血液；血统，家族；性情，气质；血气方刚，热血
